title_original: 국회의원선거구획정위원회 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall be composed of not more than 11 members, including one Chairperson. <Amended on November 7, 2003; July 2, 2007>
(2) The Speaker of the National Assembly shall appoint Committee members from among persons recommended by academic circles, the legal profession, news media, civic organizations, and election commissions, in consultation with the representative members of each negotiating party. In such cases, members of the National Assembly, local council members, and members of political parties shall not serve as Committee members. <Amended on July 2, 2007>
(3) The Chairperson shall be elected from among the Committee members.
(4) The Chairperson and other members shall serve on a non-standing basis.
